# JV Media - Video Editing Studio

> Professional video editing for content creators and brands.

## Services
- Short-form video editing (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts) - €99/video
- Long-form video editing (YouTube, Podcasts, Interviews) - €249/video
- Monthly packages - €899/month

## About
Jakob Vrabitsch runs JV Media, a video editing studio based in Austria. Nearly 2 years of experience editing for YouTube creators and brands. Specializes in clean edits, good pacing, color grading, sound design, and captions.

## Team
- Jakob - Founder & Lead Editor
- Tyrone - Video Editor
